description.zh: 擅长解释单词、拆解语法和中英互译的英语专家。讲得准确、地道，也会适时抖个机灵，让英语少一点拧巴、多一点好记。
description.en: A witty English expert for vocabulary, grammar, and Chinese-English translation. Clear, idiomatic explanations with humor that helps the lesson stick.

welcome_message.zh: 单词不懂、语法打结，还是翻译卡壳？把它扔给我。
welcome_message.en: Puzzled by a word, tangled in grammar, or stuck on a translation? Throw it my way.

description.zh: 讲清含义、语感、搭配和例句

prompt.zh: 请解释这个英语单词，包括音标、核心含义、语感、常见搭配、易混词和三个自然例句：
prompt.en: Please explain this English word, including pronunciation, core meaning, nuance, common collocations, confusing alternatives, and three natural examples:

description.zh: 从句子结构讲到为什么这样写
description.en: See the structure and why it works

prompt.zh: 请拆解下面句子的语法结构，用通俗语言解释每一部分的作用，并指出可以替换的表达：
prompt.en: Please break down the grammar of this sentence in plain language, explain each part, and suggest alternative phrasings:

description.zh: 拒绝翻译腔，保留原意和语气
description.en: Keep the meaning and lose the translationese

prompt.zh: 请把下面内容翻译成自然、地道的英语。先给最佳版本，再简要说明关键取舍：
prompt.en: Please translate the following into natural, idiomatic English. Give the best version first, then briefly explain the key choices:

description.en: Convey the meaning without word-for-word stiffness

prompt.zh: 请把下面英文翻译成准确、流畅的中文。先给译文，再解释难点或双关：
prompt.en: Please translate the following English into accurate, fluent Chinese. Give the translation first, then explain any tricky wording or wordplay:

description.zh: 比较语气、场景和搭配差异

prompt.zh: 请辨析这些英语词或表达。用一条清晰的区别规则、典型搭配和对比例句说明：
prompt.en: Please compare these English words or expressions using one clear rule, typical collocations, and contrastive examples:

description.zh: 修正错误，让表达更像母语者
description.en: Fix errors and make it sound native

prompt.zh: 请润色下面的英文。先给自然版本，再列出主要修改及原因，并保留原本语气：
prompt.en: Please polish the English below. Give the natural version first, then list the main changes and reasons while preserving the original tone:

zh: 每天「08:00」教我一个职场英语高频词，包含搭配、例句和易错点，任务创建后立即启用
每个工作日「12:30」推送一道语法辨析题，答题后再揭晓解析
每周日「20:00」复习本周学过的单词，并生成一份小测验
en: Every day at 08:00, teach me one high-frequency workplace English word with collocations, examples, and common mistakes — enable immediately
Every weekday at 12:30, send one grammar question and reveal the explanation after I answer
Every Sunday at 20:00, review this week's vocabulary and generate a short quiz
